nest eggs: Many young workers start building nest eggs early so they will have enough money when they retire.
許多年輕上班族很早就開始存儲備金，這樣退休時才有足夠的錢。
nest in the tree: Every spring, a pair of birds come back to nest in the tree outside my bedroom window.
每年春天，都有一對鳥兒回到我臥室窗外，在樹上築巢。
nested folders: My computer is full of nested folders, so it takes me forever to find the file I need.
我的電腦裡到處是巢狀資料夾，所以要找到需要的檔案得花很久。
empty nest: After their youngest son left for college, my parents felt lonely in their empty nest.
最小的兒子去讀大學後，我爸媽在空巢中感到寂寞。
net a profit: The small bakery was able to net a profit of one million dollars last year thanks to its famous pineapple cakes.
多虧了出名的鳳梨酥，那間小麵包店去年淨賺一百萬元。
net a big fish: After months of hard work, the police were finally able to net a big fish in the drug ring and put him in prison.
經過數月努力，警方終於能在販毒集團中逮到一名大人物，把他關進監獄。
net a goal: In the last minute of the game, our captain kicked the ball hard to net a goal and win the match.
比賽最後一分鐘，我們隊長用力踢球進球，贏得比賽。
cast a wide net: To find the best new teacher, the school cast a wide net and posted the job in five countries.
為了找到最好的新老師，學校廣泛搜尋，在五個國家刊登職缺。
be nicknamed the Rocket: Because he runs faster than anyone in our school, Tom has been nicknamed the Rocket since seventh grade.
因為湯姆跑得比全校任何人都快，他從七年級起就被取了綽號叫「火箭」。
nickname someone: It is not kind to nickname someone because of their weight, since it can really hurt their feelings.
因為體重而給某人取綽號並不友善，因為這真的會傷害他們的感情。
nominate a candidate: Each class will nominate a candidate to run for student council president next month.
每個班級都將提名一位候選人，參選下個月的學生會會長。
be nominated for an award: The young singer was nominated for an award after her first album sold over a million copies.
那位年輕歌手的首張專輯賣出超過一百萬張後，入圍了獎項。
nominate a day: Let's nominate a day next week when everyone can stay after school to clean the classroom.
我們來指定下週的一天，讓大家都能放學後留下來打掃教室。
note the difference: Look at these two photos carefully and note the difference between the old station and the new one.
仔細看這兩張照片，注意舊車站和新車站之間的差異。
note down: The teacher asked us to note down the important dates on the board before the bell rang.
老師要我們在鐘響前把黑板上的重要日期記下來。
be noted for: This small town is noted for its hot springs, which attract thousands of visitors every winter.
這個小鎮以溫泉聞名，每年冬天都吸引成千上萬的遊客。
take note of: Please take note of the emergency exits when you get on the plane, just in case something happens.
上飛機時請留意緊急出口，以防萬一發生什麼事。
of note: Nothing of note happened at the meeting, so you didn't miss anything by staying home.
會議上沒發生任何值得注意的事，所以你待在家並沒有錯過什麼。
on a positive note: The principal ended her speech on a positive note by telling us how proud she was of our hard work.
校長以正面的話作結，告訴我們她對我們的努力有多驕傲。
notify the police: If you see a stranger trying to open your neighbor's door at night, you should notify the police at once.
如果你看到陌生人晚上試圖打開鄰居的門，應該立刻通知警方。
be notified by email: All students will be notified by email if school is closed because of the typhoon.
如果學校因颱風停課，所有學生都會以電子郵件收到通知。
notify in advance: If you cannot come to the dentist on Friday, please notify the clinic in advance so someone else can take your time.
如果你星期五不能來看牙醫，請事先通知診所，讓別人可以使用你的時段。
number among the best: With its fresh seafood and friendly service, this restaurant numbers among the best in the city.
這家餐廳有新鮮的海鮮和親切的服務，名列全市最佳之一。
number in the thousands: The volunteers who will come to clean the beach after the oil spill are expected to number in the thousands.
漏油事件後預計前來清理海灘的志工將數以千計。
one's days are numbered: The old shop owner knows that his days are numbered now that a huge supermarket has opened next door.
隔壁開了一家大型超市，那位老店主知道他的店來日無多了。
number the pages: Before you hand in your report, remember to number the pages so the teacher can read them in order.
交報告前記得標頁碼，這樣老師才能按順序閱讀。
nurse a grudge: He has nursed a grudge against his brother for years because of a small fight over money.
因為一場為錢起的小爭吵，他多年來一直對哥哥懷恨在心。
nurse a cold: I stayed home all weekend to nurse a cold, drinking hot tea and sleeping a lot.
我整個週末待在家養病治感冒，喝熱茶並多睡覺。
nurse a drink: Since he has to drive home later, he will nurse a drink for two hours while his friends keep ordering more.
因為他等一下要開車回家，他會把一杯飲料慢慢啜飲兩小時，而朋友們一直點更多。
nurse an ambition: Ever since she was a little girl, she has nursed an ambition to become a famous chef.
她從小就懷抱著成為知名主廚的野心。
nurse a patient: It takes great patience to nurse a patient who cannot walk or eat without help.
照顧一位沒有協助就無法走路或進食的病人需要極大的耐心。
nurse the economy back to health: After the long war, the new leaders worked hard to nurse the economy back to health.
長期戰爭之後，新的領導人努力讓經濟恢復健康。
